title: Task and architectural optics

specimens.name: Glass edge light injector
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Broad thin clear glass sheet corner, its straight polished edge pressed flush against a small dark optical shoe through a visible thin clear pad. Side cutaway shows the pad sandwiched between two flat contact faces and the dark wraparound baffle. No projecting rod.

specimens.name: Deep overhead cutoff grid
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. One isolated unpowered physical specimen. One wedge-shaped block of deep straight light channels and one cropped mounting rib. No slanted vent blades.

specimens.name: Rail side-light prism
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. One isolated unpowered physical specimen. One removed narrow hard prism, asymmetrical angled exit face and exposed mounting tenon.

specimens.name: Inspection slit aperture
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One long opaque blank metal face with one extremely thin dark horizontal slit cut THROUGH it. Show tiny dark rib ends inside the slit, no bars across it, no wide recessed opening or grille.

specimens.name: Near-field edge diffuser
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. One isolated unpowered physical specimen. One short concave matte diffuser segment with opaque central ledge, no closed ring or mirrored cup.

specimens.name: Step side-light outlet
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. One short stair nosing profile viewed from BELOW. Vertical front fascia is solid and blank. Single recessed narrow diffuser lies entirely on the horizontal underside behind front lip, facing directly down. Show underside clearly. Unpowered.

specimens.name: Wall bounce reflector
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. One isolated unpowered physical specimen. One open parabolic leaf with integral back stop, no emitter or closed cup.

specimens.name: Task light shutter
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One closed opaque shutter flap mounted to an exposed cylindrical pivot along top edge. Show the rectangular aperture frame behind the flap in three-quarter cutaway. Flap overlaps frame on both sides and along lower edge, fully blocking opening. No glass, airflow hardware or light.
